answer: Pay seats by real demand, not headcount. Every job an agent sells carries a 10% fee that is burned, and each epoch's bonus pool is split by fee-paying revenue, capped at 0.05 tokens of bonus per token earned (rates assumed). A clone ring buying its own work burns 10 to win 5, so wash trading loses money and a thousand idle clones earn zero. Seen through that prism, the onyx-black farm and the opal-bright honest agent separate on their own: only the one customers pay keeps glowing.
